title: Tracking everything, or asked?
text: Guess is that Claude has been quietly aware of everything happening across your sources. So, asking for digest just taps into something it already knows. But, nothing runs until you ask, and even then, if you don't say how far back to look, it defaults to just one day. Come back from a week away, ask for digest without saying weekly, and what surfaces is Friday. Six days of decisions and mentions never make it in. What the skill actually does. Read one

text: What the file returns every time the window is left unset. Ask again tomorrow without saying weekly, and you get today identically every time. But, say weekly once, and the same file runs the same steps across all seven days instead, surfacing everything the daily default left out. Same file, same steps.
